STAGE 1 - inventory of the promoted tree
GOAL: find where the proposed cocond-markov-poincare-ot mechanism is supposed to live.
READ: glob **/* of .../trees/round_20261028_221240_652/cocond-markov-poincare-ot -> only train_rqvae.py, model/{__init__,utils,layers,model}.py, logs/, __pycache__/.
OBSERVED:
 - model/model.py:11 imports ".layers"; model/__init__.py:3 imports RQLayer/VQLayer from .layers. model/utils.py is imported by nothing (no "from .utils" / "import utils" anywhere; grep found only "torch.utils" in train_rqvae.py:34).
 - model/layers.py:1-7 docstring states it "intentionally keeps RecBole3.0's contracts: Euclidean residual quantization".
 - model/layers.py:98-113 VQLayer._distances is the Euclidean squared-distance expansion and _indices is argmin / argmax over a Euclidean Sinkhorn.
 - grep for markov|transition|diffus|adj|successor|cocond|barycenter|einstein|klein had ZERO hits in any .py.
 - Hyperbolic helpers exist only in the dead model/utils.py (artanh:17, mobius_add:30, expmap0:42, poincare_distance:55, HVectorQuantization:162, HResidualVectorQuantization:279). Nothing constructs them.
 - .pyc files: model/layers.cpython-39.pyc contains no poincare/markov symbols; there is no model/utils pyc at all, i.e. utils.py was never imported in any run.
REASONING: the promoted tree is the untouched Euclidean baseline; the curved quantizer in utils.py is inherited, unreferenced code.
OPEN: confirm integration (ARM_NAME/RESULT_DIR, SINGLE_GPU_ENV branch, SID export) and write the verdict.

STAGE 2 - results (final)
CHECK a (behaviour x geometry fidelity): FAIL. Exercised path is train_rqvae.py:319 model(batch) -> model/model.py:28 self.rq(encoded) -> model/layers.py:283-289 RQLayer.forward -> layers.py:185/121 _indices(_distances(latent)) -> layers.py:98-113 Euclidean squared distance + argmin / Euclidean-Sinkhorn argmax. No transition matrix, no Markov diffusion, no Poincare cost, no barycenter anywhere (grep zero hits). model/utils.py hyperbolic code is unreferenced (no import; no .pyc) - exactly the "inherited unused hyperbolic code" non-qualifier.
CHECK b (trainability): the Euclidean baseline trains (STE at layers.py:133, quant_loss 132). But there is no behaviour/geometry switch at all: assignment is unconditional Euclidean argmin, sk only on the last level (layers.py:260-261). So the coupled pathway cannot change SID or gradients on/off. FAIL.
CHECK c (integration): ARM_NAME="TIGER_RQ-VAE" (train_rqvae.py:58) -> RESULT_DIR = results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE, the BASELINE arm; the tree's own recorded run wrote results/stage2_RQ-VAE/_conformance/TIGER_RQ-VAE (logs/training_metrics.jsonl:3). LOG_DIR (line 66) points at <repo>/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE/logs, outside results/. No SINGLE_GPU_ENV branch (grep zero hits) though logs/train_migrated.log:1 shows the arm it was copied from had one. SID export itself (train_rqvae.py:195-208, 421-427) is correct and uniquely indexed.
VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX (4 blocking/major findings).
